ms.report:
Response To Milestone Signoff Rejection After Acceptance
Hello to the Catalyst Grantors, we greatly appreciate your time and feedback throughout this process before both Grantor Reviewers accepted our Milestone PoA to allow it to head to the sign-off stage for the final review. Your tenacity and consistent feedback is commended and we appreciate your acceptance, on behalf of the whole team we thank you for your collaboration throughout this process.
In the milestone signoff page, the final Milestone Reviewer left us the following feedback:
"The links to the evidence are all private. Unless there is sensitive information, all the files should be public. Please change the settings of the files and make sure they are all public. If you believe a document should be private and only shared with the reviewers, clearly explain your reasons. Thanks" - Milestone Reviewer
We thank the Milestone Reviewer for their feedback in the final Signoff Phase and submit the following response:
In our Proposal, we made the decision not to open-source the developments we realize throughout this Proposal's timeline. This was a decision we did not make lightly, but ultimately we weighed our abilities to remain competitive in a market - that is becoming more monopolized with each year - with multi-billion dollar players. Keeping our links private is aligned with our Proposal Promise that we made to the Cardano Community when they voted on our Proposal with overwhelming support. We want to ensure we sustain that promise to this amazing ecosystem, our supporters, our users, and for our company as a whole. In a business sense, it really deprives our ability to properly market and deploy these products without companies from other ecosystems building their own replicas.
We have made these links and Proof-of-Achievement available to all Catalyst Grantors, and we invite the Milestone Reviewer to review them in depth to visualize the massive scope of accomplishments achieved in Milestone One. Howev
